name: Penn BioPond
description: I spent a lot of time here during my master’s. One of the greenest, calmest spots on campus.

name: Philadelphia Museum of Art
description: Saw Sunflowers and Water Lilies and much, much more.

name: Spruce Street Harbor Park
address: 301 S Christopher Columbus Blvd, Philadelphia, PA 19106
description: Watch the sun rise over Camden.

name: Devil's Pool
description: Beautiful nook along the Wissahickon. Authorities are constantly telling people not to swim here because there is poop in the water, but I’ve never seen this pool empty.

name: Hangry Joe's
description: Korean chain that has, in my opinion, perfect Nashville-style fried chicken wings. I used to live near here during grad school, it was the best.

name: Yi Pin Szechuan Cuisine
description: Another late-night favorite. I love their wonton soup.

name: Reading Terminal Market
description: Philadelphia's historic indoor food market, open since 1893.

name: Belmont Plateau
description: I’ve seen many beautiful sunsets overlooking the city from here after spending a day at adjoining Fairmount Park.

name: Vernick Food & Drink
description: My sister used to work here! Favorite menu and incredible team.
